gateway connect failed: GatewayClientRequestError: unauthorized: device token mismatch (rotate/reissue device token)
Pending: 0 · Paired: 1
{"role":"operator","tokenDelivery":"withheld-cross-device"}
Local cached operator device token for cli (0eab85f6…) predates the gateway rotation. This is a stale device-token pattern and can fail with device token mismatch.
